advancements.husbandry.wax_on.title: Wax On
advancements.husbandry.wax_on.descriptio: Apply honeycomb to copper blocks to protect them from oxidizing.

copperequipments.midnightconfig.title: Copper Equipments Configs
copperequipments.midnightconfig.axeRequi: In the crafting menu, combine an oxidized block with any axe to scrape it.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.axeDurab: Scraping in the inventory will reduce the axe’s durability.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.axeRequi: In the crafting menu, combine a waxed block with any axe to remove the wax.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.axeDurab: Unwaxing in the inventory will reduce the axe’s durability.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.itemOxid:
Choose how copper items oxidize:
[None] Items never oxidize naturally.
[Durability] Oxidation stage is determined by durability:
 • 100–75% → Unexposed
 • 75–50% → Exposed
 • 50–25% → Weathered
 • 25–0% → Oxidized
[Time] Items oxidize gradually over time based on their lifespan.
[Both] Items oxidize based on both durability and lifespan, with weighted influence.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.maxLifes:
Defines how long an item can exist before reaching full oxidation when using time-based methods.
For example, 36000 ticks = 30 minutes of real time.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.alphaWei:
Controls how strongly durability influences oxidation when using the 'Durability and Time' method.
Higher values make damage more important in determining oxidation progression.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.betaWeig:
Controls how strongly lifespan influences oxidation when using the 'Durability and Time' method.
Higher values make item age more important in determining oxidation progression.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.oxidatio:
Defines how often the game attempts to progress oxidation.
Lower values = more frequent checks.
For example, 200 ticks = every 10 seconds of real time.
⚠ Warning: Setting this too low may cause performance issues due to excessive oxidation checks.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.waxedUni: Changes block textures to show subtle honey details.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.waxedInd: Adds a small yellow dot to waxed items.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.copperHo: Adds a recipe to craft the copper horse armor.
copperequipments.midnightconfig.isServer: The mod detects whether your Minecraft client is hosting the world. If you are not the host, it will warn you that certain options are unavailable.
